exposure: Presence of a dedicated obstetrics and gynecology resident for postpartum family planning counseling
outcome: Uptake of immediate postpartum family planning
cohort: Mothers who delivered at Saint Paul's Hospital Millennium Medical College (SPHMMC) in Addis Ababa, Ethiopia.
finding: The presence of a dedicated obstetrics and gynecology resident for postpartum family planning counseling was associated with an increase in the uptake of immediate postpartum family planning.
